title: Env contract: one typed schema for every key (required-when, type, range, default), ETH_RPC_URL as the required key, legacy CONFIG removed

options.name: Keep the presence-only list and the legacy CONFIG
options.risk: The list and .env.example drift from what the code reads (AUD-DB-016); ALCHEMY_URL is required while preflight demands ETH_RPC_URL (AUD-DB-011); dead constants remain two sources of truth.

options.name: Generate validation, the env list and an .env.example sync test from one schema; make ETH_RPC_URL required with ALCHEMY_URL as an alias; delete the legacy CONFIG addresses and constants
options.behavior_impact: Boot refuses malformed or contradictory settings with one clear message; documentation matches the code.
options.risk: A broad refactor of config loading (Phase 27 territory); a .env that boots today may refuse to boot.

recommendation: typed-schema, sequenced with card OD-25 (align-one-parser) so the risk keys and the rest share one module.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); S3.
behavior_impact: Decides how settings are validated and which keys are required.
needed_by: Phase 27 discussion (env module), coordinated with OD-25 in Phase 24
